notes: Nebius Token Factory exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.
Use NEBIUS_API_KEY in the process environment; never commit keys.
The router checks /v1/models when a key is available and picks the first available model for each task.

research.purpose: Read sources, form trading hypotheses, and decide what is worth testing.

models.why: Reasoning-heavy default for source synthesis and hypothesis formation.
Large thinking model for broad research synthesis when available.
Large instruct fallback with long context.

idea.purpose: Turn rough notes into concrete strategy ideas.

models.why: Large instruct model for structured idea generation.

coding.purpose: Write backtestable strategy rule-code from approved ideas.

models.why: Nebius recommends this for coding-agent workflows.
Smaller coding fallback for faster runs.

summary.purpose: Summarize stage inputs, outputs, and next actions.

models.why: Fast summary default; fast flavor is preferred for low-latency status updates.
Base fallback for the same summary model.

pipeline.purpose: Review generated code specs and backtest outcomes.

models.why: Strong JSON and report-writing model for pipeline review.
Large fallback for reviewing generated strategies.
